caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden door with a diagonal hatching pattern, suggesting either texture or shading, in a reddish-brown color. The door is set within a stone frame composed of rectangular blocks in shades of light yellow, beige, and gray, with visible joint lines between the stones. Above the door, the frame extends into a pointed arch with a rounded top, decorated with alternating pale orange, brown, and grayish shapes to create a marbled effect. At the bottom left of the doorway, there is a small decorative stone element. The background is an off-white color, and the drawing is signed “Cordena Jackson” in the bottom right corner.
title: Carved Stone Doorway, Mission San Carlos Borromeo
